results.note: Expositio super canonem missae (anonymous): No English translation found in literature or translation inventories. This is a specialized liturgical commentary on the canon of the Mass.
Fragmenta ex Ordinario: Very small fragment (289 words) from a liturgical ordinal. No English translation found.
Fragmenta: Small liturgical fragment (1,303 words). No English translation identified.
Monitio episcopi ad ordinandos: Medieval episcopal ordination instruction (535 words). No English translation found.
Nomina excommunicandorum: Very brief list/fragment (63 words). No translation found.
Officium infantum: Medieval liturgical office for the Feast of Holy Innocents (538 words). Referenced in scholarship but no complete English translation found.

Officium sepulcri: Medieval Easter liturgical drama. Scholarly sources reference this as an important liturgical drama text, but no complete English translation of this specific medieval text is evident. Academic literature discusses the form but translation status is ambiguous.
Officium stellae: Medieval Epiphany liturgical drama (505 words). Important in medieval liturgical drama scholarship but no complete English translation of this specific version found.

Ordinarium canonicorum regularium S. Laudi Rotomagensis: Liturgical ordinal for the Regular Canons of Saint Laudus, Rouen (13,139 words). No English translation found; remains in Latin in scholarly collections.
Ordinatio episcopi: Medieval bishop ordination ritual/ordo (1,333 words). Liturgical ordination text; no complete English translation of this anonymous medieval version found.
Processiones solemnes: Medieval solemn procession ordinal (2,744 words). Described in liturgical scholarship but no English translation of this specific text located.
Quaedam digna notatu: 'Certain noteworthy matters' (1,684 words). Anonymous collection; no English translation found.
Sermones ad populum: Anonymous sermons to the people (7,858 words). Exists in medieval sermon collections but no specific English translation of this anonymous Migne version identified.
Tabula paschalis: Easter tables/calculation aid (263 words). Technical liturgical aid; no English translation found.
Vetus ordo ad instituendum canonicum regularem: Medieval ordination ordo for Regular Canons (944 words). Liturgical text; no English translation located.
Vita S. Audomari: Life of Saint Audomari/Saint Omer (2,889 words). No English translation found in available scholarly sources or translation inventories.

Vita S. Oswaldi: Life of Saint Oswald. Multiple medieval vitas of St. Oswald exist (Byrhtferth, Eadmer), both translated into English (Oxford Medieval Texts; Clarendon Press 2006), but unclear if Migne PL 150 version matches one of these known translations.
De thesauro Canusinae ecclesiae transmisso Romam: On the treasure of the church of Canusae sent to Rome (482 words). No English translation found.
Dodechinus abbas in additionibus ad Chronicon Mariani Scoti: Additions to Marianus Scotus's Chronicle (99 words). Brief fragment; no English translation identified.

Vita S. Anselmi Lucensis: Life of Bishop Anselm II of Lucca (12,722 words). Draft translations of extracts exist on Academia.edu relating to Matilda of Tuscany and Canossa, but no complete published English translation found.
Vita Tiemonis: Life of Tiemon (3,767 words). No English translation found in available sources.
Vita et res gesta S. Altmanni: Life and deeds of Saint Altmann, bishop of Passau (10,068 words). Published in multiple Latin editions but no English translation identified.
Aliud epitaphium: Another epitaph/epitaphium (250 words). No English translation found.
Catalogus nobilium qui immediate praedia tenuerunt: Catalog of nobles (1,021 words). Historical list; no English translation located.
Chronicon breve Nortmannicum: Brief Norman Chronicle (1,221 words). Probably an 18th-century forgery per André Jacob; no English translation found.
Cognomina nobilium qui Willelmum in Angliam secuti sunt: Names of nobles following William to England (143 words). Historical list; no English translation found.
De inventione corporis S. Anastasii: On the discovery of the body of Saint Anastasius (168 words). No English translation identified.
De rebus gestis in Majori monasterio saeculo XI: Deeds in the Major monastery in the 11th century (5,758 words). Medieval monastery history; no English translation found.
Epitaphium Willelmi: Epitaph of William (44 words). Very brief epitaph; no translation found.

'Deeds of the Bishops of Cambrai, Translation and Commentary' by Bernard S. Bachrach, David S. Bachrach, and Michael Leese (Routledge, 2018). Modern scholarly English translation with extensive commentary. Also cited as Gesta episcoporum Cameracensium by earlier scholars.
Magnates superstites anno XX regni Willelmi: Surviving magnates in the 20th year of William's reign (211 words). Historical list; no English translation found.

Meditatio in orationem Dominicam: Meditation on the Lord's Prayer (3,419 words). Medieval devotional text; no specific English translation of this anonymous Migne version found, though similar works exist.
Meditatio super Salve Regina: Meditation on the Salve Regina (0 words recorded). No English translation found for this specific anonymous medieval work.

Meditationes de gestis Jesu Christi: Meditations on the deeds of Jesus Christ (2,558 words). Similar works in the Pseudo-Bonaventure tradition have translations, but unclear if this specific Migne version is identical to translated works.

Meditationes de passione Jesu Christi: Multiple Middle English translations exist from the 14th-15th centuries. Related to Pseudo-Bonaventure's 'Meditationes Vitae Christi,' translated into Middle English as 'The Mirror of the Blessed Life of Jesus Christ' by Nicholas Love (c.1400) and earlier standalone 'Meditationes de Passione Christi' versions in Middle English from the last quarter of the 14th century.
Chronicon Beccense: Chronicle of Bec Abbey (18,811 words). Important historical source for Bec Abbey under Lanfranc; Latin editions exist but no English translation identified.
Dies obitualis: Death day record/calendar (414 words). Liturgical aid; no English translation found.
Miraculum quo B. Maria subvenit Guillelmo Crispino: Miracle where the Blessed Virgin aided William Crispin (2,756 words). No English translation identified.
Vita Bosonis: Life of Boso (3,370 words). No English translation found.
Vita Letardi: Life of Letard (359 words). No English translation identified.

Vita S. Augustini Cantuariensis: Life of Saint Augustine of Canterbury (7,402 words). While Goscelin and others wrote about Augustine, no specific English translation of this anonymous Migne version identified.
Vita Theobaldi Becci: Life of Theobald of Bec (502 words). No English translation found.
Antiqua collectio ecclesiasticorum hymnorum: Ancient collection of ecclesiastical hymns (1,950 words). Liturgical hymn collection; no English translation of this specific medieval compilation found.

'Queenship and Sanctity: The Lives of Mathilda and the Epitaph of Adelheid' edited and translated by Sean Gilsdorf (Catholic University of America Press, 2004). Modern scholarly English translation including the 'Vita Mathildis antiquior.'
Carmen de Joseph Patriarcha: Poem on Joseph the Patriarch (70 words). Very brief verse; no English translation found.
